verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the transparency hub's reference to Acceptable Use enforcement reporting, which implies a usage policy exists without showing its content or clarity. Transparent per-token pricing and a published deprecation policy touch commercial terms only tangentially. Missing for 10: the usage policy text itself and its list of prohibited uses, commercial terms of service (ownership of outputs, permitted resale), data-handling/retention/training commitments, and any evidence the policy is written in plain language.
